about: The source model of a Zarr v3 store, listed or zipped (spec/zarrify/zarr3.md §7 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr3.md#7-zarr-v3-profile>): the roles a node's zarr.json plays, an array's members among them, and, in the zip form, the zip file's end records, entries and documents, each with the constraints a store must meet to have the convention's layout. The parser reads the listing or the zip file's central directory, then every candidate's zarr.json (JSON by spec/zarrify.md §1.6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify.md#16-json-documents>), and checks this schema for each node, from the root down; the projection reads a valid IR and checks nothing.

about.grids: the chunk grids whose chunk keys the convention computes (spec/zarrify/zarr3.md §3.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr3.md#31-chunk-grids-and-chunk-keys>)
about.encodings: the chunk key encodings, by name: the separator when the configuration gives none
about.separators: the separators a chunk key encoding takes

elements.about: The IR of a Zarr v3 store. Names in angle brackets are variables.

store form.about: spec/zarrify/zarr3.md §4.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr3.md#41-elements>: the store's directories and objects (conventions §8.9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/conventions.md#89-stores>), and in each node document read, a value per top-level member

zip form.entries/<i>: struct: the local header and data of central directory entry i, for each object that is not empty
zip form.entries/<i>/data: a node document read (ascii[n] when stored, derived {"transform":"deflate"} when deflated), or any other object (bytes[n] of its data as stored: its compressed bytes when compressed)
zip form.central_directory/entries/<i>: struct: header {signature:<u4,version_made:<u2,version_needed:<u2,flags:<u2,method:<u2,time:<u2,date:<u2,crc32:<u4,compressed_size:<u4,size:<u4,name_length:<u2,extra_length:<u2,comment_length:<u2,disk:<u2,internal:<u2,external:<u4,local_header_offset:<u4}, name ascii[n], extra bytes[n], comment ascii[n]
zip form.gaps/<offset>: gap: bytes no element claims (the local headers and data of empty, ignored and superseded entries, data descriptors)

given.object: the document is a JSON object
given.attributes_ok: attributes is absent or an object

constraints.message: {key} is not a JSON object
{key}: zarr_format is not 3
{key}: node_type {node_type} is not array or group
{key}: attributes is not an object

array.about: an array's zarr.json (spec/zarrify/zarr3.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr3.md#3-arrays>): the members the convention reads; shape_ok, grid_ok and the other flags are the parser's verdicts on the members' forms

given.shape_ok: shape is an array of at most 32 integers from 0 to 2^53 - 1
given.grid_ok: chunk_grid's configuration is that grid's for n dimensions
given.encoding_ok: chunk_key_encoding is an object with a string name and, if any, an object configuration

constraints.message: {path}: shape {shape} is not up to 32 sizes
{path}: chunk grid {grid} is not supported
{path}: chunk grid {grid} is not one of {n} dimensions
{path}: chunk key encoding {encoding} is not supported
{path}: separator {separator} is not . or /
{path}: storage_transformers is not empty
{path}: zarr.json has no data_type
{path}: zarr.json has no fill_value
{path}: codecs is not a nonempty array

given.counts: its two entry counts are equal

constraints.message: a zip file that spans several disks
a zip file's entry counts differ
a zip entry on another disk
a zip entry is encrypted
a zip entry's name is not UTF-8
the stored zip entry {key} has a compressed size other than its size

given.total: the sizes of the deflated documents read

constraints.message: the deflated documents are larger than 2^27 bytes together
